description: Customer & Supplier Management: Create CustomerRepository and SupplierRepository, implement customer and supplier list/add/edit screens, purchase recording screen with batch info, customer debt tracking with partial payments, and customer ledger view. Enables credit sales and purchase management.
steps: Create src/services/repositories/customerRepository.ts following productRepository pattern. Methods: getAll(options?: {search?}), getById(id), create(data: {name, phone?, address?, notes?}), update(id, data), delete(id) (soft delete if has balance, hard delete if balance=0), getCustomersWithDebt() filtering current_balance > 0, updateBalance(customerId, newBalance) helper.
Create src/services/repositories/supplierRepository.ts with same methods: getAll(search?), getById(id), create(data: {name, phone?, email?, address?, notes?}), update(id, data), delete(id).

Create src/services/repositories/purchaseRepository.ts. Methods: getAll(filters?: {supplierId?, startDate?, endDate?}), getById(id), create(data), getPurchaseWithItems(id) joining purchase_items. Create will use executeTransaction to: insert purchase record, insert purchase_items, create stock_batches for each item, update products.current_quantity, record PURCHASE stock movements.

Create src/services/repositories/customerLedgerRepository.ts. Methods: getAll(customerId, filters?: {startDate?, endDate?}), create(data: {customerId, type: 'CREDIT_SALE' | 'PAYMENT', amount, balance, referenceId?, notes?}). Ledger maintains running balance of customer debt.

Create src/hooks/useCustomers.ts with TanStack Query hooks: useCustomers(search?), useCustomer(id), useCustomersWithDebt(), useCreateCustomer(), useUpdateCustomer(), useDeleteCustomer(). Create src/hooks/useSuppliers.ts with parallel hooks for suppliers.

Create src/hooks/usePurchases.ts with usePurchases(filters?), usePurchase(id), usePurchaseWithItems(id), useCreatePurchase(). Create src/hooks/useCustomerLedger.ts with useCustomerLedger(customerId, filters?), useRecordPayment() mutation.

Create src/app/(tabs)/customers/index.tsx screen with FlatList of customers. Each card shows name, phone, current balance (formatted with formatCurrency, highlight in red if > 0). Search bar at top. FAB to navigate to add customer screen. Tap card to view customer details.

Create src/app/(tabs)/customers/add.tsx and src/app/(tabs)/customers/[id].tsx for add/edit customer. Form: name (required), phone, address, notes. Use Input components and Button. Call useCreateCustomer or useUpdateCustomer. Edit screen includes delete button (validate current_balance === 0 before hard delete, otherwise soft delete).
Create src/app/(tabs)/suppliers/index.tsx and src/app/(tabs)/suppliers/add.tsx and src/app/(tabs)/suppliers/[id].tsx parallel to customer screens. Form: name (required), phone, email, address, notes.

Create src/app/(tabs)/purchases/add.tsx screen for recording purchases. Form: supplier picker (from useSuppliers), date picker (default today), notes. Dynamic item list: each row has product picker (from useProducts), quantity input, unit cost input (convert to minor units), batch info (manufacturing date, expiry date, received quantity = quantity). Add/remove item buttons. Calculate total. Amount paid input. On submit: executeTransaction to: insert purchase, insert purchase_items, create stock_batches for each item with batch_number=PURCH-{purchaseId}-{index}, update products.current_quantity += quantity, record PURCHASE stock movements for each item.

Create src/app/(tabs)/customers/[id]/ledger.tsx screen showing customer ledger. Load with useCustomerLedger(customerId). FlatList showing: date (formatDateTime), type (CREDIT_SALE or PAYMENT), amount, running balance, reference (sale receipt number or payment reference), notes. Color code: credit sales in red, payments in green. Show current balance at top. Include 'Record Payment' button.

Create src/components/customers/PaymentModal.tsx for recording partial debt payments. Form: amount input (validate <= customer.current_balance), payment method (CASH, MOBILE_MONEY), reference (if mobile money), notes. On submit: executeTransaction to: insert payment record with customer_id (no sale_id), insert customer_ledger entry type='PAYMENT' with amount as negative, update customers.current_balance -= amount. Close modal and refresh ledger.

Update checkout screen from FEAT-003 to enable credit sales: when CREDIT payment method selected, show customer picker (useCustomers). On checkout with credit: set sale.customer_id, sale.credit_amount = remaining unpaid amount, sale.amount_paid = sum of other payments, create customer_ledger entry, update customer.current_balance.
acceptance_criteria: CustomerRepository and SupplierRepository provide full CRUD operations with search
Customer list shows name, phone, and debt balance highlighted if > 0
Supplier list shows name and contact info
Add/edit screens for customers and suppliers validate required fields (name)
Customer delete validates balance = 0 for hard delete, otherwise soft delete
Purchase recording screen captures supplier, items with batch info (expiry, manufacturing date, costs), and creates stock batches atomically
Purchase transaction updates products.current_quantity, creates stock_batches with batch_number PURCH-{id}-{index}, records PURCHASE movements
Customer ledger shows running balance with CREDIT_SALE and PAYMENT entries, color coded
PaymentModal records partial debt payments, updates customer balance and ledger atomically
Credit sales in checkout flow assign customer, create ledger entry, update customer balance
All financial amounts in minor units, displayed with formatCurrency
verification: Run npx tsc --noEmit and npx expo lint to confirm no errors
Create a customer with name and phone, verify appears in customer list with balance 0
Create a supplier, verify appears in supplier list

Record a purchase: select supplier, add 2 products with expiry dates and costs, verify purchase created, stock_batches created with PURCH-{id}-{index} format, products.current_quantity increased, PURCHASE movements recorded

Complete a credit sale from POS: add items to cart, checkout with CREDIT, select customer, verify sale created with customer_id, customer_ledger entry created type=CREDIT_SALE, customer.current_balance increased by credit amount
View customer ledger, verify credit sale appears with positive balance
Record a partial payment from ledger screen, enter amount < balance, select CASH, verify payment recorded, customer_ledger entry created type=PAYMENT, customer.current_balance decreased
Attempt to delete customer with balance > 0, verify soft delete or rejection
Create customer with balance 0, delete, verify hard delete succeeds
Enable airplane mode, create customer and supplier, verify offline functionality
